rules.title: Fair Chance in Housing Act: no criminal history inquiry before a conditional offer
rules.requirement: A housing provider may not ask about an applicant's criminal record, orally, in writing, or on an application, until after making a conditional offer. The only exceptions are a methamphetamine manufacturing conviction on federally assisted housing premises and lifetime sex offender registration.
rules.coverage_conditions: Housing providers (landlords, owners, lessors, sublessors, agents) offering rental dwelling units for residential purposes in New Jersey.
rules.exemptions: Dwelling units in owner-occupied premises of not more than four dwelling units. Providers may consider methamphetamine manufacture on federally assisted housing premises and lifetime sex offender registration before a conditional offer.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Exempt if owner-occupied premises with four or fewer units

rules.penalty: Enforced through Division on Civil Rights complaints only (no private court action). Up to $1,000 for a first violation, up to $5,000 with one prior violation in 5 years, and up to $10,000 with two or more prior violations in 7 years. Remedies may include a conditional offer, unit provision, refund of the application fee, and up to $1,000 paid to the applicant.

rules.title: Fair Chance in Housing Act: written disclosure before accepting an application fee
rules.requirement: Before accepting any application fee, a housing provider must disclose in writing whether its eligibility criteria include review of criminal history. The disclosure must also state that the applicant may submit evidence of inaccuracies, rehabilitation, or mitigating factors.
rules.coverage_conditions: Housing providers of rental dwelling units in New Jersey.

rules.title: Fair Chance in Housing Act: records that can never be considered
rules.requirement: Housing providers may never evaluate applicants based on the following records: arrests or charges without conviction, expunged convictions, pardoned convictions, vacated convictions, juvenile adjudications, or sealed records.
rules.coverage_conditions: Housing providers of rental dwelling units in New Jersey, both before and after a conditional offer.
rules.exemptions: Dwelling units in owner-occupied premises of not more than four dwelling units.

rules.title: Fair Chance in Housing Act: conviction lookback periods and individualized assessment
rules.requirement: After a conditional offer, providers may consider only specified serious convictions and recent indictable convictions within set lookback windows. Withdrawing an offer requires an individualized assessment, a showing by preponderance of the evidence of a substantial, legitimate, nondiscriminatory interest, and written notice with an opportunity to appeal. Applicants may request, within 30 days, the information relied on, which must be provided free within 10 days.

rules.title: Fair Chance in Housing Act: ban on advertisements excluding people with criminal records
rules.requirement: Housing providers may not publish advertisements or use applications stating that applicants with arrests or convictions will not be considered, except for the methamphetamine and lifetime sex offender registration exceptions. Providers also may not disseminate or misuse an applicant's criminal record.
rules.coverage_conditions: Housing providers of rental dwelling units in New Jersey.
rules.exemptions: Dwelling units in owner-occupied premises of not more than four dwelling units. Statements about methamphetamine manufacture on federally assisted housing premises and lifetime sex offender registration are allowed.

rules.title: Fair Chance in Housing Act: ban on drug or alcohol testing of applicants
rules.requirement: Housing providers may not require applicants to take a drug or alcohol test. They also may not request consent to obtain information from a drug abuse treatment facility.
